title: Intensity-Modulated Radiation Therapy (IMRT)
description: Medicare coverage criteria for intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT). Covered for head and neck cancers, prostate carcinoma, or CNS tumors where 3D conformal radiation cannot deliver the prescribed dose without exceeding normal tissue tolerance of adjacent critical organs.

criteria.name: Head and Neck, Prostate, or CNS Malignancy Near Critical Organs
criteria.description: Biopsy-proven head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, or brain/spinal tumor located adjacent to critical dose-sensitive structures.
criteria.clinical_intent: Confirm clinical diagnosis qualifying for inverse-planned modulation
criteria.cms_document: Medicare LCD Intensity Modulated Radiation Therapy

criteria.name: Dosimetric Proof of 3D Conformal Inadequacy
criteria.description: Documented comparison confirming 3D conformal radiation would exceed safe dose constraints to parotid glands, rectum/bladder, or optic nerves.
criteria.cms_document: Medicare LCD Intensity Modulated Radiation Therapy

criteria.name: Simple Palliative Bone Metastases Exclusion
criteria.description: IMRT requested for uncomplicated palliative irradiation of non-spinal bone metastases where 3D conformal or simple fields are standard.
criteria.clinical_intent: Exclude inverse-planned IMRT for simple palliative treatments
criteria.cms_document: Medicare LCD Intensity Modulated Radiation Therapy
